title: canthium cordatum
intro: Canthium cordatum, commonly known as Red Cestrum, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae, native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with several health benefits, including the reduction of blood pressure, improvement in digestion, and the relief of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Canthium cordatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal and therapeutic effects.
